If those procurements are conducted under BQK's own rulebook, restricted procedures, or vendor-direct renewal, the tender record will never surface them and the pipeline must rely on financial statements, audit reports and vendor-side announcements instead.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the network calls behind the prokurimihapur.org and OSHP search UIs for JSON endpoints; if none, budget for HTML scraping plus PDF parsing, and consider a formal access-to-public-documents request to KRPP for bulk notice data.

brief: Kosovo's procurement record for this cell rests on four official pillars — the e-Prokurimi national portal and its KRPP/PPRC rulebook and annual-report document tree, the OSHP/PRB complaint and decision search (the richest single view, exposing appellants, estimated values, panel members and cited PPL articles), the National Audit Office report repository, and the Official Gazette for the underlying laws — with the Central Bank (BQK) running its own separate notice board at bqk-kos.org/shpalljet/tenderet/. The critical open question is whether BQK procures under the general Public Procurement Law or under its own Executive-Board rulebook (amended October 2024), since that determines whether its RTGS/ACH payment-infrastructure tenders are ever publicly noticed or appealable at all; no ATS/RTGS/ACH procurement document was found in any of the three languages this run. Two civil-society layers materially improve usability — Demokraci Plus's enriched OSHP decisions database and Lëvizja FOL's Prokurimi i Hapur contract aggregator — but both show last-update dates over a year old and must be freshness-checked before operational reliance. Practical constraints: bqk-kos.org returns HTTP 403 to plain fetching and needs a browser-based collector (bot-defended, not dead), Serbian-language material exists only as translated document trees on the same sq-primary domains rather than as a parallel source ecosystem, and no documented API for notices or decisions was confirmed.
